text:
emma: Clearing out a vintage mid-century sideboard (walnut veneer) — 60" long, two sliding doors, inside shelves. Solid but has a small water ring on top. Free for pickup Soma office. Will need two people to move. DM to claim and coordinate time.
leo: Photos? dims in cm?
emma: Pics: https://imgur.com/a/example (DM me for hi-res). Dimensions are 152cm x 45cm x 78cm.
sarah: omg that would fit perfectly in my living room. can you hold it til sunday?
emma: Can hold until Sunday afternoon. Pickup needs to be between 10-2.
mike: I can help move if needed. Got a dolly and van.
sarah: @mike you are a hero :heart: would you be free midday?
mike: Yup, can make 12:30.
facilities-bot: Reminder: Large-item curbside pickup allowed at Soma loading dock between 11-3 on weekends. Please sign the pickup log and bring a mask.
emma: Thanks @facilities-bot. I'll leave a sticky note with my name & phone.
leo: If sarah takes it I can swing by to help load. If not I might borrow it for my studio.
sarah: DM sent emma — confirmed! Thanks mike and leo for the muscle.
emma: Claim pending with sarah; will update here if anything changes. Also keeping the set of brass drawer pulls if anyone wants them separately (will give away for free).
mike: Nice. If plans change I'm nearby and can grab it.
sarah: All good, see you Saturday 12:30 at Soma loading dock. Thanks emma! :tada:
